quests.title: Before the Visit
quests.summary: A heritage visit is coming. The chapel and graves at East Point need tending, and someone should listen to the island.

steps.text: Collect whitewash and brushes from Chief Stoker Marsh at the Marina Boathouse.
Take them to the Heritage Warden at East Point, and stay until dusk.
Catch a Ravanne near East Point at dusk and show it to the warden.

quests.reward: A Miniature Ravanne, fish curry, and the warden's thanks.
